title: Resend has no verified people.frequencylocal.com domain, so conversational mail cannot send from its default address

source.ref: catch-up scan 2026-10-20; phase plan phase 3; PROG-EMAIL1

detail: FILED 2026-10-20. THE CONSEQUENCE: DEFAULT_CONVERSATION_ADDRESS is people@people.frequencylocal.com (lib/comms/from-address.ts) and Resend has no verified people.frequencylocal.com domain, so a 1:1 conversation send from the house address is refused by the provider until the domain verifies. Owner action, no code: add the domain in Resend, copy the DNS records it shows into the frequencylocal.com zone (Vercel DNS), wait for Verified. Click-by-click steps are in the project thread.

verify.evidence: OPEN. Closes when Resend lists people.frequencylocal.com as Verified and one test message from people@people.frequencylocal.com is accepted by the provider.
